violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -The floor of the two door refrigerator is dirty and needs wiped out. -The door handles of the two door refrigerator have a build up of dough and need cleaned. -Racks have a build up of white powder and need wiped down.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -The walk-in freezer floor needs cleaned. -The production floor/dough prep area has a build up of dough dust and needs cleaned.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing.-Discovered portion serving utensils in the dry food bins that are stored in the product. Portion utensils should not be stored in product.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Attachments to walls and ceilings (e.g. light fixtures, vent covers, decorations etc..)* were not cleanable and/or maintained in good repair.- The fan by the entryway between the front counter and baking area have an accumulation of dirt on the blades.
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
